overview.description: Growing mammalian cells (HEK293, CHO) underpins therapeutics, antibody production, and cell-based assays. It is aseptic technique at a higher stakes level: slow-growing, contamination-prone cells in a CO2 incubator, passaged before they over-confluence.
objectives: passage adherent/suspension cells at the right confluence
maintain sterility in a biosafety cabinet with slow-growing cells
understand CO2/bicarbonate media buffering and why phenol-red matters
detect and prevent contamination - including invisible mycoplasma

steps.description: Growing mammalian cells (HEK293, CHO) underpins therapeutics, antibody production, and cell-based assays. It is aseptic technique at a higher stakes level: slow-growing, contamination-prone cells in a CO2 incubator, passaged before they over-confluence.
steps.intro: Mammalian culture is aseptic technique with no margin: a doubling time of a day means a single contamination event costs a week, so discipline in the hood is everything.

instructions.title: Work in the hood
instructions.description: Warm media, wipe everything with 70% ethanol, and keep a clean laminar-flow field; never breathe over open vessels.

instructions.title: Monitor confluence
instructions.description: Check under the microscope; passage before cells over-grow (contact inhibition/stress changes phenotype).

instructions.title: Passage
instructions.description: Trypsinise (adherent) or split (suspension) to the right seeding density; count cells for reproducible splits.

instructions.title: Guard against contamination
instructions.description: Watch media colour (phenol-red pH), and test routinely for mycoplasma - it is invisible by eye but wrecks data.

submission.description: Outline a passaging routine for a cell line including confluence judgement, seeding density, and how you would monitor for contamination (bacterial, fungal, mycoplasma).

kits.name: Cell lines & complete media
kits.note: Authenticated lines to passage - but this needs a hood + CO2 incubator and BSL-2 practice.

kits.name: Community-lab bench time
kits.note: Safest route to real mammalian culture: use a shared, properly-equipped BSL-2 space.
